visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with short black hair and glasses, wearing a black button-down shirt and blue jeans, stands in a studio setting. Behind him is a wooden bookshelf filled with books and small objects. He looks directly at the camera with an intense, slightly furrowed expression, gesturing with both hands spread wide. He makes a "six" gesture with his right hand toward the end of this phase. (2) The man holds up a square card with an educational illustration of the water cycle labeled "What is Groundwater?" in Traditional Chinese. The illustration shows mountains, rain, a river, and arrows pointing to groundwater layers. His hands are visible at the bottom of the card. (3) The shot cuts to a medium view of a wide, turbulent river with murky brown water and white foamy rapids. No people are visible. (4) The man returns, holding a card with a still from the movie "Marriage Story" showing a woman sitting on a chair. He gestures emphatically with his free hand while talking. (5) He swaps the card for another still showing a man sitting on a sofa from the same movie. The studio lighting is bright and even. (6) He holds a card showing an aerial view of a large concrete dam in a mountainous area. The water in the reservoir is blue-green. (7) He holds an illustration card labeled "Groundwater Recharge Zone" showing how water infiltrates the soil through "micro-levees." Red circles appear on the card to highlight specific elements. (8) He holds a card with an aerial view of a green pond area surrounded by lush trees and agricultural fields under bright daylight. (9) He holds a card with a close-up image of a ginger cat from "Puss in Boots" with large, pleading eyes. He continues to speak with high energy and varied hand gestures.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 原來我們一直誤會的水利科學No.6. [Logo]: 泛科學. (2) [Slogan]: 什麼是地下水?. [Subtitle]: 地下水不是像變了心的另一半, 永遠回不來了. (3) [Subtitle]: 只要河水流得夠慢, 就會緩慢滲入土地, 補充地下水. (4) [Subtitle]: 但濁水溪這個浪子跑得太快. (5) [Subtitle]: 它的河道坡度陡, 水流匆匆忙忙連滾帶爬. (6) [Subtitle]: 來不及滲入土地就直奔大海, 讓濁水溪兩岸的地下水得不到充分補充. (7) [Subtitle]: 面對這個困境, 水利署的工程師們化身水利界的感情諮商師. (8) [Subtitle]: 提出濁水溪揚塵改善及河川環境復育. (9) [Subtitle]: 他們不打算蓋高聳的水壩強行囚禁水. (10) [Subtitle]: 強留是沒有用的. (11) [Subtitle]: 在地質條件適合地下水入滲補注的區域, 如濁水溪. (12) [Subtitle]: 配合河川疏濬及揚塵改善工程時, 就地取材. (13) [Subtitle]: 用河流清出的砂石, 順著水流堆出一道道小土丘. [Slogan]: 地下水補注區. (14) [Subtitle]: 形成河槽補注池, 進行地下水復育工作. (15) [Subtitle]: 你看, 這些小土丘就像是河水的減速坡. (16) [Subtitle]: 讓原本只停留幾分鐘的河水, 延長到數小時. (17) [Subtitle]: 而水流經過小土丘會被攤開成一大片淺灘, 增加河水滲透的區域. (18) [Subtitle]: 形成補注池, 讓土地有更多機會接觸河水, 更容易滲透成功. (19) [Subtitle]: 就這樣, 原本一心奔向大海的浪子被這些減速坡打動. (20) [Subtitle]: 它放慢了腳步, 願意停下來好好溝通. (21) [Subtitle]: 利用這多出來的相處時間, 河水就能從容不迫、游刃有餘地滲入地底. (22) [Subtitle]: 補充被抽走的地下水. (23) [Subtitle]: 根據監測, 濁水溪自從開始進行河槽地下水補注後. (24) [Subtitle]: 雲林沿海地區的地下水位平均回升了將近兩公尺. (25) [Subtitle]: 所以, 誰說地下水不能補?. [Logo]: 經濟部水利署 廣告. (26) [Subtitle]: 關鍵不是能不能, 而是我們懂不懂挽回的藝術. (27) [Subtitle]: 與其築起高牆當恐怖情人, 不如學學水利署給對方一個慢下來的理由.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The male narrator starts with high-pitched, energetic speech at a fast rate. Background music (BGM) begins immediately, featuring an acoustic guitar-driven pop melody with a steady, mid-tempo beat. The acoustic environment is clean studio quality. (2) A sharp "pop" sound effect (SFX) occurs, marking a visual transition. The narrator's voice maintains a friendly and animated tone with frequent pitch modulation. (3) A distinct "whoosh" sound of rushing water overlaps the narration as river imagery is presented. The BGM remains at a consistent volume, providing a rhythmic bed. (4) Another "ding" SFX accompanies the appearance of a new card. The narrator's speech rate remains high, with very few pauses. (5) A cartoonish "boing" SFX plays as the narrator points to a specific graphic on a card. The BGM tempo remains stable around 120 BPM. (6) A final "ding" SFX occurs as the brand logo appears. The narrator concludes with a slightly lower pitch and a confident, professional cadence.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Problem -> Technical Solution -> Data Evidence -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to educate the public about groundwater replenishment techniques used by the Water Resources Agency. It uses a romantic relationship metaphor to simplify complex water science concepts, explaining how slowing down the Zhuoshui River's flow allows for better land infiltration.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video ends with a brand logo and specific department name for the Water Resources Agency, Ministry of Economic Affairs.
